purpose: Expose public-safe proof that Mac Henry distinguishes evidence quality without exposing private Brain scoring or strategy.
governance_rules: Unverified evidence cannot alone justify a major policy or weighting change.
Stale or expired evidence must not be treated as current evidence.
Correlated sources must not be counted as fully independent confirmations.
Material contradictions require review before confidence can be elevated.
Insufficient sample size must remain visible in the confidence proof.
Evidence classification is not execution authority.
Public Henry may verify evidence-quality labels but may not see private Brain scoring weights or strategy.
